name: comp-117
title: Like Count Button
blurb: Thumbs-up like button with a count badge on the right side.
description: An outline button with thumbs-up icon, 'Like' text, and a count badge (86) with a divider line separator.
use_when: Showing like counts with a prominent like action.
avoid_when: When the like count is dynamic or needs state management.
a11y: Icon is aria-hidden. Count is visible in the badge.
